summary:
Reviewed d842f89, the same change as the reported 15b3801 rebased by the merge (branch work/w128 is gone). Adds work outcome, turn and resolve (scripts/workqueue_request.py) for requests r8-r12.
No change under features/, no test removed or weakened. The allowances row 'none' holds. Check: ruff, vulture and import-linter clean. Size: nothing over 300.
The r8-r12 scenarios pass (5).
Important, fix now: work turn puts a delivered request back to accepted (reproduced). r8 and r9 read literally ask for this, so it needs a line ruling.
Two Minor observations: an out-of-range outcome line lets turn settle a line with no outcome; resolve with no --line sets delivered with an empty resolution.
questions: Important, scripts/workqueue_request.py:70-75: work turn from the upstream on a delivered request whose lines are all settled resets the status to accepted, losing r11's delivered (reproduced). r8 and r9 need a ruling that they hold only for a request not yet delivered.
